title: AI Security & Governance
description: Techlio secures and governs applications, cloud and AI systems: security assessments, access hardening, AI risk documentation and audit trails, automated checks in the pipeline, monitoring and response.
h1: AI you can defend *to a security team and a regulator.*
intro: Buyers now ask how an AI system is secured, governed and audited before they sign. We assess, harden and document the applications, cloud accounts and AI features your business runs on, and the engineers who find a weakness are the ones who fix it in code.
caption: A code change passes secret scanning, code analysis, dependency and infrastructure checks, then a security review, before deployment and runtime monitoring.

card.lead: Pass the security review, and deserve to.
card.text: Security assessments, access hardening, AI risk documentation and automated checks in every release, across your app, cloud and AI features.

offerIntro: Four stages, in order. Each one leaves you with evidence you can show a customer or an auditor.

offerings.title: Assess
offerings.text: Threat model, architecture and code review, cloud configuration review and an inventory of where AI touches your data. Findings are ranked by real risk, with the fix described for each.

offerings.title: Harden
offerings.text: Role-based access, multi-factor authentication, secrets management, tenant isolation and least-privilege permissions for both people and AI agents, implemented in your codebase.

offerings.title: Govern
offerings.text: The engineering side of AI governance: risk classification of each AI use, model and data documentation, human oversight points and audit trails, organised around frameworks such as the EU AI Act and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework.

offerings.title: Automate and monitor
offerings.text: Secret scanning, code analysis, dependency and infrastructure checks on every change, plus logging, alerting and incident runbooks with a named owner.

whyTitle: Why engineering teams bring us in

why.title: Engineers who fix, not just report
why.text: You get merged pull requests alongside the findings. A PDF of issues with no owner is where most security work stalls.

why.title: AI attack surface included
why.text: Prompt injection, data leakage through retrieval and over-permissioned agent tools are tested the same way as the rest of your application.

why.title: Evidence for buyers and auditors
why.text: Access controls, test results, model documentation and audit trails are produced as we go, which shortens security questionnaires and compliance reviews.

closeTitle: Facing a security review, or want one before a customer asks?
closeText: Tell us what you run and who is asking. You will get a first read on scope and priorities within 24 hours.

faqs.question: Do you provide legal or compliance advice?
faqs.answer: No. We do the engineering work that compliance depends on, such as access controls, documentation, logging and audit trails, and we work alongside your legal or compliance advisers.

faqs.question: Can you secure an AI system someone else built?
faqs.answer: Yes. We start with an assessment of the existing system and its data flows, then fix the highest-risk findings first.

faqs.question: What does an AI security assessment cover?
faqs.answer: Access control, data exposure, prompt injection and misuse risks, logging and audit trail, third-party model and vendor risk, and the documentation a security review or regulator will ask for.

faqs.question: How do you test for prompt injection?
faqs.answer: We run adversarial tests against the system's inputs, documents and tools, then add screening, permission limits on actions and human approval for high-impact steps.

faqs.question: Can you help us prepare for the EU AI Act?
faqs.answer: We help with the engineering side: classifying systems, documenting how they work, logging decisions and adding human oversight. Legal interpretation remains with your counsel.

metaTitle: AI Security, Governance and DevSecOps Services
answer: Techlio's AI security and governance service makes an AI system defensible to a security team and a regulator. We assess the risks, harden access and data handling, test for prompt injection and misuse, add logging and human oversight, and produce the documentation reviews ask for.
